title: City of London Emergency Help Points
summary: Nearest trauma and emergency hospitals, urban hazards, and essential supply points for the Square Mile.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): 82 Whitechapel Road, Whitechapel E1 1FR. From Liverpool Street station: ~20 min walk east along Bishopsgate and Whitechapel High Street (~1 mile), or take bus 25 or 205 east (~10 mins).
- University College Hospital (UCH): 235 Euston Road, London NW1 2BU. From Moorgate station: take bus 205 west along City Road and Euston Road (~25 mins).
- St Thomas' Hospital: Westminster Bridge Road, London SE1 7EH. From Blackfriars station: ~25 min walk south-west across Blackfriars Bridge and west along Upper Ground / Belvedere Road (~1.3 miles).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- The Royal London Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, 82 Whitechapel Road, E1 1FR (co-located with A&E).

3. Local Hazards
- High density of high-rise commercial and residential towers: widespread power failure immediately halts elevators and electronic door security systems, and cuts off pumped water to upper floors.
- River Thames tidal embankment risk along Victoria Embankment and Lower Thames Street during extreme surge events.

4. Essential Supplies
- Retail pharmacies and food markets located along Cheapside, Moorgate, Bishopsgate, and Fleet Street can provide bottled drinking water, power banks, and basic medications.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
